jobs.description:
Looking for a flexible delivery driver job in Oosterhout? Join Albert Heijn Online through Consolid and earn €18.83 gross per hour. Wat bieden wij? €18.83 gross per hour (all-in) including holiday allowance and shift bonuses; 25 paid vacation days (full-time basis); Pension scheme from your first working day; Travel reimbursement up to 45 km; Flexible contract between 12 and 32 hours per week; Choose your own availability; Three-day buddy training programme; Employee discount on groceries with the Albert Heijn Bonus Card; Independent work with long-term career opportunities. Functieomschrijving Albert Heijn Delivery Driver | Oosterhout | Start Quickly Your day starts at the Albert Heijn Online depot at Linie 11 in Oosterhout. You collect your handheld scanner, receive your delivery route and carefully load your delivery van with customer orders. You will independently deliver groceries to customers throughout Oosterhout and nearby areas. Every delivery is completed with excellent customer service, making sure groceries arrive safely and on time. You answer customer questions, process payments when required, collect empty crates and verify age-restricted products according to Dutch regulations. After completing your route, you return to the depot, unload your van and report any important updates before ending your shift. Because every route is different, you'll enjoy plenty of variety throughout your working week. Do I need previous experience? No. You will receive full training before driving independently. Can I choose my working days? Yes. Your schedule is based on the availability you provide. Is this an active job? Absolutely. Besides driving, you'll regularly lift grocery crates and stay active throughout the day. Functie eisen Albert Heijn Delivery Driver | Oosterhout | Start Quickly Valid Category B driving licence; Available for at least two shifts each week; Available for at least two Saturdays every month; Willing to work morning and/or evening shifts;

Able to communicate in Dutch and/or English; Customer-focused, reliable and physically fit. Excited about this Delivery Driver vacancy in Oosterhout? Apply today! For more information, call or WhatsApp Seyyedon 0683110102 or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
